digest.component_or_area: workflow step registry and module size guards
propositions: Registration of workflow steps occurs as a process-global import side effect with no static validation, making missed registrations invisible to linters and schema checks
Two files (plan_review/workflow_ops.py at 794 LOC and llm/config.py at 793 LOC) lack headroom guards while holding code that needs protection against unchecked growth
Existing seam test guards have stale or incomplete coverage: gate_dispatch_seam asserts on a file that no longer contains the finalize_verdict call sites it justifies itself by
An unregistered workflow step cannot be caught before runtime because the workflow schema treats step names as free-form strings and the linter skips validation for unknown steps
Registry membership must be verified on a first import (via subprocess isolation) because test imports can mask missing production imports in normal pytest execution
Gate YAML step resolution must be checked against STEP_REGISTRY using the same subprocess isolation to detect missing registration imports that would silently pass in-process
